topic.title: BMI Calculator
topic.description: Calculates Body Mass Index from height and weight and categorizes the result as underweight, normal, overweight, or obese. Combines arithmetic and multi-branch conditionals.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Performing BMI formula calculations, using if-elif-else chains for ranges, and rounding results.
learningNotes.challenges: Getting the condition ranges correct and handling zero-height edge cases.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Add GUI or export results to a file.

files.description: Basic BMI calculation without category labels.
Refined BMI calculator with improved output.
